item.title: No street cleaning Maple Crescent, 8th October
item.description:
Good morning There appears to be no street cleaning being carried out in Maple Crescent. Once again the Council contractor responsible isn't adhering to the Service contract with the LB of Bexley. We regularly undertake litter picking in the road but this is not a substitute for not sweeping our road. Furthermore as residents we are paying increased council tax charges and not getting services we pay for. Please can this be investigated as to why the road isn't being swept regularly and request that the road is swept regularly please.
